$purpose: Freely-usable (public-domain / CC0 / CC BY / royalty-free) video & audio aligned to FRQNCY, sourced by a 10-agent web sweep. Not wired into the live site.

$tiers.free: Commercial reuse OK, NO attribution required (Public Domain, CC0, royalty-free-no-credit).
$tiers.credit: Commercial reuse OK WITH attribution (CC BY, CC BY-SA, royalty-free-with-credit). CC BY-SA also requires ShareAlike on derivatives.
$tiers.restricted: NOT free to reuse commercially — NonCommercial (NC), NoDerivatives (ND), embed/stream-only, or license unconfirmed. Link or embed only.
